releases.summary: Added a new Management Tool for controlling tool availability, improved clearance checking with progress and cancellation support, and enhanced BETA indicators and update dialogs.

changes.title: Management Tool
changes.description: Added a new Management Tool that allows users to manage the availability of individual tools within the toolkit by enabling or disabling them.

changes.title: Clearance Check Progress
changes.description: Added a progress bar while checking doors for clearance clashes, with the option to cancel the operation at any time.

changes.title: BETA Tool Icons
changes.description: Updated the icons of tools under development to include a BETA label, making them easier to identify.

changes.title: Update Cancellation
changes.description: Updated the Revit close dialog shown during the update process by renaming the Close button to Cancel Update to better clarify its action.

changes.title: Clashed Doors Schedule Reminder
changes.description: Added an Ignore option to the clashed doors schedule update reminder, allowing users to stop the reminder from appearing again for the remainder of the current Revit session.

changes.title: Worksharing Synchronization and Relinquish
changes.description: Added a toggle button to the Auto Elevation window that synchronizes the workshared model and relinquishes element ownership when the tool session ends.

releases.summary: Added version information and update controls, improved update management, and introduced BETA labels for tools under development.

changes.title: Version Information
changes.description: Added an Info button to the About panel in the IBIM tab, allowing users to view the installed version and the changes introduced in the latest version.

changes.title: Manual Update Check
changes.description: Added a Check Update button to the About panel in the IBIM tab, allowing users with a valid license to manually check for available updates.

changes.title: New Version Notification
changes.description: The Check Update button now changes to notify the user when a new version is available.

changes.title: Automatic Update Installation
changes.description: The update mechanism has been enhanced to automatically download the MSI package when a new version is available and launch the installation process afterward.

changes.title: BETA Labels
changes.description: Added a BETA label to the title bars of the Clearance Check and Fire Rating Check windows to indicate that these tools are still under development.

releases.summary: Fixes for Revit 2027 add-in deployment and the SheetMatrix tolerance issue.

changes.title: SheetMatrix Tolerance
changes.description: A tolerance value is introduced to enhance the detection of viewport locations relative to the matrix.

changes.title: Revit 2027 Deployment Fix
changes.description: Fixed an issue preventing proper deployment of add-in files for Revit 2027.

releases.summary: Improved version availability notifications and added Revit 2027 support.

changes.title: Revit 2027 Support
changes.description: The add-in is now compatible with Revit 2027.

changes.title: New Version Availability Notifications
changes.description: Enhanced the version-checking mechanism to notify users when a new version is available.

releases.summary: Fix: Sheet Tools Turning Off Unexpectedly

changes.title: Fixed Sheet Tools Turning Off Unexpectedly
changes.description: Resolved an issue that caused the Sheet Tools to become disabled after running for a period of time.
